_comment: What WordPress registers when this plugin runs, from wp_get_abilities() and wp_get_ability_categories() on WordPress 7.2-beta4. 'abilities' and 'categories' are what a static scanner should report. 'vendored' comes from a bundled library; whether to list it is undecided. 'runtime_only' names are built from data, so no scanner can recover them. 'requires_woocommerce' registers only with WooCommerce active and was not checked at runtime. 'must_not_report' are look-alikes.
